text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/submission/solution.in
+# Nb [001] impact: Fellinger, Park and Wilkins EAM/alloy potential.
+# Metal units: distance Angstrom, time ps, velocity Angstrom/ps.
+units metal
+dimension 3
+atom_style atomic
+boundary p p f
+
+# Axis-aligned BCC lattice; a is supplied in the potential header.
+variable a equal 3.3079
+variable lateral equal 20.0*v_a
+# Cut region bounds between atomic planes to retain exactly 20 and 40 cells.
+variable projectile_hi equal 19.75*v_a
+variable target_lo equal 20.0*v_a
+variable target_hi equal 59.75*v_a
+# Initial adjacent planes are a/2 apart; translate target to make gap = 15 A.
+variable gap_shift equal 15.0-0.5*v_a
+
+lattice bcc ${a} orient x 1 0 0 orient y 0 1 0 orient z 0 0 1
+# Vacuum permits free-surface expansion throughout the impact run.
+region simulation block 0.0 ${lateral} 0.0 ${lateral} -1000.0 2000.0 units box
+region projectile_block block 0.0 ${lateral} 0.0 ${lateral} 0.0 ${projectile_hi} units box
+region target_block block 0.0 ${lateral} 0.0 ${lateral} ${target_lo} ${target_hi} units box
+create_box 1 simulation
+create_atoms 1 region projectile_block
+create_atoms 1 region target_block
+group projectile region projectile_block
+group target region target_block
+displace_atoms target move 0.0 0.0 ${gap_shift} units box
+
+mass 1 92.90638
+pair_style eam/alloy
+pair_coeff * * /app/inputs/prompt3.potential Nb
+neighbor 2.0 bin
+neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes
+
+timestep 0.001
+thermo 1000
+thermo_style custom step time atoms temp pe ke etotal press
+
+# Start both bodies at rest apart from their 300 K thermal velocities.
+velocity projectile create 300.0 4928459 mom yes rot no dist gaussian
+velocity target create 300.0 7328949 mom yes rot no dist gaussian
+# Fixed simulation box, 300 K NVT, 100 ps (100000 steps at 0.001 ps).
+fix equilibration all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
+run 100000
+unfix equilibration
+
+# Add +[001] impact velocity: 20 A/ps = 2 km/s, preserving thermal motion.
+velocity projectile set 0.0 0.0 20.0 sum yes units box
+# Adiabatic impact and subsequent release/expansion for 50 ps.
+fix impact all nve
+run 50000
*** End Patch"));
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src = Path('/app/submission/solution.in').read_text()
Path('/app/smoke.in').write_text(src.replace('run 100000', 'run 20').replace('run 50000', 'run 50'))
PY",max_output_tokens:1000}));
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"/opt/lammps/bin/lmp -in /app/smoke.in -log /app/smoke.log",workdir:"/app",yield_time_ms:1000,max_output_tokens:4000}));

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from lammps import lammps
src = Path('/app/submission/solution.in').read_text()
setup = src.split('# Start both bodies')[0]
lmp = lammps(cmdargs=['-log', 'none', '-screen', 'none'])
lmp.commands_string(setup)
n = lmp.get_natoms()
assert n == 48000, n
masks = lmp.extract_atom('mask')
coords = lmp.extract_atom('x')
# Groups are defined in order: all, projectile, target.
pz = [coords[i][2] for i in range(n) if masks[i] & 2]
tz = [coords[i][2] for i in range(n) if masks[i] & 4]
assert len(pz) == 16000, len(pz)
assert len(tz) == 32000, len(tz)
gap = min(tz) - max(pz)
assert abs(gap - 15.0) < 1e-10, gap
print(f'Geometry verified: projectile={len(pz)}, target={len(tz)}, gap={gap:.12f} Angstrom')
print(f'Projectile z planes: {min(pz):.8f} to {max(pz):.8f} Angstrom')
print(f'Target z planes: {min(tz):.8f} to {max(tz):.8f} Angstrom')
print(f'Boundary periodicity: {lmp.extract_box()[5]}')
lmp.close()
allowed = set('units dimension atom_style boundary variable lattice region create_box create_atoms mass group pair_style pair_coeff neighbor neigh_modify velocity timestep fix unfix run thermo thermo_style displace_atoms'.split())
for number, line in enumerate(src.splitlines(), 1):
    command = line.split('#', 1)[0].strip()
    if command:
        assert command.split()[0] in allowed, (number, command)
print('All submitted commands are within the supported command set.')
PY",workdir:"/app",yield_time_ms:1000,max_output_tokens:2000}));
